title: HBSE 10th Compartment Result 2026 – Out
organization: Board of School Education Haryana (BSEH / HBSE)
vacancyDetails: Compartment / supplementary result for Haryana Board Class 10 examinations 2026
qualification: Students who appeared in BSEH Class 10 compartment / supplementary exams
applicationFee: As paid during compartment form (if any)
selectionProcess: Compartment Examination → Result Declaration → Marksheet / DigiLocker
documentsRequired: Roll number, admit card details; school details for marksheet collection
howToApply:
1. Visit https://bseh.org.in
2. Open Class 10 Compartment Result
3. Enter roll number

shortDescription: HBSE / BSEH Class 10 Compartment Result 2026 is out. Check marks with roll number at bseh.org.in.
content:
The Board of School Education Haryana (BSEH / HBSE) has declared the Class 10 Compartment / Supplementary Result 2026.

Students who appeared in the Secondary compartment examination can check pass status subject-wise on the official portal.

How to check

  1. Visit bseh.org.in
  2. Open Class 10 Compartment Result 2026
  3. Enter roll number
  4. Download / print the result
